/*********************************************************************/
/* Macros to denote protocols                                        */
/*********************************************************************/

#define IPPROTO_IP         0          /* choose default              */
#define IPPROTO_HOPOPTS    0          /* IPv6 Hop-by-Hop options @A5A*/
#define IPPROTO_ICMP       1          /* Internet Control Message    */
#define IPPROTO_TCP        6          /* Transmission Control        */
#define IPPROTO_EGP        8          /* Exterior Gateway            */
#define IPPROTO_PUP       12          /* Parc Universal Packet       */
#define IPPROTO_UDP       17          /* User Datagram               */
#define IPPROTO_IPV6      41          /* IPv6                    @A5A*/
#define IPPROTO_ROUTING   43          /* IPv6 Routing header     @A5A*/
#define IPPROTO_FRAGMENT  44          /* IPv6 fragment header    @A5A*/
#define IPPROTO_ESP       50          /* encaps security payload @A5A*/
#define IPPROTO_AH        51          /* authentication header   @A5A*/
#define IPPROTO_ICMPV6    58          /* ICMPv6                  @A5A*/
#define IPPROTO_NONE      59          /* IPv6 no next header     @A5A*/
#define IPPROTO_DSTOPTS   60          /* IPv6 Destination options@A5A*/
#define IPPROTO_RAW      255          /* Raw IP                      */
#define IPPROTO_MAX      256          /* maximum protocol            */

/*********************************************************************/
/* Macros for IP level options (via setsockopt() and getsockopt())   */
/*********************************************************************/

#define IP_OPTIONS         5          /* IP header options           */
#define IP_TOS            10          /* IP type-of-service          */
#define IP_TTL            15          /* IP time-to-live             */

#define IP_MULTICAST_IF   20          /* Multicast interface     @A2A*/
#define IP_MULTICAST_TTL  25          /* Multicast time-to-live  @A2A*/
#define IP_MULTICAST_LOOP 30          /* Multicast loopback      @A2A*/
#define IP_ADD_MEMBERSHIP 35          /* Add IP group membership @A2A*/
#define IP_DROP_MEMBERSHIP 40         /* Drop IP group membership@A2A*/
#define IP_DONTFRAG        55         /* IP don't fragment flag      */

#define IP_BLOCK_SOURCE           65  /* Block data from a given source
                                         to a given group        @A7A*/
#define IP_UNBLOCK_SOURCE         70  /* Undo block source       @A7A*/
#define IP_ADD_SOURCE_MEMBERSHIP  75  /* Join src-specific grp   @A7A*/
#define IP_DROP_SOURCE_MEMBERSHIP 80  /* Leave src-specific grp  @A7A*/
#define IP_RECVPKTINFO    96          /* Receive IPv4 pkt addr   @A8A*/
#define IP_PKTINFO        97          /* IPv4 pkt addr ancillary @A8A*/
#define IP_RECVLCLIFADDR  99          /* IP receive local interface
                                         address                 @A3A*/
#define IPV6_V6ONLY         100       /* Restrict to IPv6 only   @A5A*/
#define IPV6_RECVHOPLIMIT   101       /* Receive hop limit       @A5A*/
#define IPV6_UNICAST_HOPS   IP_TTL              /*               @A5A*/
#define IPV6_MULTICAST_IF   IP_MULTICAST_IF     /*               @A5A*/
#define IPV6_MULTICAST_HOPS IP_MULTICAST_TTL    /*               @A5A*/
#define IPV6_MULTICAST_LOOP IP_MULTICAST_LOOP   /*               @A5A*/
#define IPV6_JOIN_GROUP     IP_ADD_MEMBERSHIP   /*               @A5A*/
#define IPV6_LEAVE_GROUP    IP_DROP_MEMBERSHIP  /*               @A5A*/
#define IPV6_DONTFRAG       IP_DONTFRAG         /*               @A6A*/
#define IPV6_CHECKSUM       105                 /*               @A5A*/
#define IPV6_RECVDSTOPTS    110  /* Receive destination options  @A7A*/
#define IPV6_HOPLIMIT       115  /* ancillary data hop limit     @A5A*/
#define IPV6_DSTOPTS        120  /* Set/Receive dest opts post hr@A7A*/
#define IPV6_RECVHOPOPTS    125  /* Receive hop-by-hop options   @A7A*/

#define IPV6_RECVPKTINFO    140  /* Receive IP addr+interfaceindx@A7A*/
#define IPV6_PKTINFO        145  /* Set/Receive source IP/index  @A7A*/

#define ICMP6_FILTER        150                 /*               @A5A*/

#define IPV6_RECVPATHMTU    155  /* Ancillary data path MTU size @A7A*/
#define IPV6_PATHMTU        160  /* Retrieve dest path MTU size  @A7A*/
#define IPV6_USE_MIN_MTU    165  /* Enable path MTU discovery    @A7A*/
#define IPV6_RECVRTHDR      170  /* Receive routing header       @A7A*/
#define IPV6_RTHDR          175  /* Set/Receive routing header   @A7A*/
#define IPV6_RTHDRDSTOPTS   180  /* Set/Receive dest opts pre hdr@A7A*/
#define IPV6_RECVTCLASS     185  /* Receive traffic class        @A7A*/
#define IPV6_TCLASS         190  /* Set/Receive traffic class    @A7A*/

#define MCAST_JOIN_GROUP          200 /* Join an any-srce group  @A7A*/
#define MCAST_BLOCK_SOURCE        205 /* Block data from a src   @A7A*/
#define MCAST_UNBLOCK_SOURCE      210 /* Unblock data from src   @A7A*/
#define MCAST_LEAVE_GROUP         215 /* Leave an any-src group  @A7A*/

/*********************************************************************/
/* Flags to set IPV6_ADDR_PREFERENCES for preferred source address   */
/*********************************************************************/
#define IPV6_PREFER_SRC_HOME   0x00000001 /* Prefer Home addr    @A8A*/
#define IPV6_PREFER_SRC_COA    0x00000002 /* Prefer Care-of addr @A8A*/
#define IPV6_PREFER_SRC_TMP    0x00000004 /* Prefer Temp addr    @A8A*/
#define IPV6_PREFER_SRC_PUBLIC 0x00000008 /* Prefer Public addr  @A8A*/
#define IPV6_PREFER_SRC_CGA    0x00000010 /* Prefer CGA addr     @A8A*/
#define IPV6_PREFER_SRC_NONCGA 0x00000020 /* Prefer non-CGA addr @A8A*/

/*********************************************************************/
/* Macros for Internet address specifications                        */
/*********************************************************************/

#define INADDR_ANY        (u_long)0x00000000  /* any local address   */
#define INADDR_BROADCAST  (u_long)0xffffffff  /* broadcast address   */
#define INADDR_LOOPBACK   (u_long)0x7f000001  /* loopback address    */
#define INADDR_NONE               0xffffffff  /* A "-1" returned
                                                 from inet_addr()    */
#define INADDR_UNSPEC_GROUP    (u_long)0xe0000000 /* 224.0.0.0   @A2A*/
#define INADDR_ALLHOSTS_GROUP  (u_long)0xe0000001 /* 224.0.0.1   @A2A*/
#define INADDR_MAX_LOCAL_GROUP (u_long)0xe00000ff /* 224.0.0.255 @A2A*/

#define IN6ADDR_ANY_INIT      {0, 0, 0, 0}    /* any local addr  @A5A*/
#define IN6ADDR_LOOPBACK_INIT {0, 0, 0, 1}    /* loopback addr   @A5A*/
#define INET_ADDRSTRLEN       16              /* ip4 text len    @A5A*/
#define INET6_ADDRSTRLEN      46              /* ip6 text len    @A5A*/

                                         only, since OS/400
                                         restricts port access via
                                         CFGTCP configuration        */

#define IP_DEFAULT_MULTICAST_TTL   1  /* Limit mcasts to 1 hop   @A2A*/
#define IP_DEFAULT_MULTICAST_LOOP  1  /* Recv sends if a member  @A2A*/
#define IP_MAX_MEMBERSHIPS        200 /* Max per socket     @A2A @A7C*/

/*********************************************************************/
/* Macros for number representation conversions                      */
/*********************************************************************/

#define htonl(qso_htonl) (qso_htonl)  /* host byte order to long     */
#define htons(qso_htons) (qso_htons)  /* host byte order to short    */
#define ntohl(qso_ntohl) (qso_ntohl)  /* long to host byte order     */
#define ntohs(qso_ntohs) (qso_ntohs)  /* short to host byte order    */

/*********************************************************************/
/* Macros for definitions of bits in internet address integers       */
/*********************************************************************/

#ifndef IN_CLASSA
  #define IN_CLASSA(i)       (((long)(i) & 0x80000000) == 0)  /* @A1A*/
#endif
#ifndef IN_CLASSA_NET
  #define IN_CLASSA_NET      0xff000000                       /* @A1A*/
#endif
#ifndef IN_CLASSA_NSHIFT
  #define IN_CLASSA_NSHIFT   24                               /* @A1A*/
#endif
#ifndef IN_CLASSA_HOST
  #define IN_CLASSA_HOST     0x00ffffff                       /* @A1A*/
#endif
#ifndef IN_CLASSA_MAX
  #define IN_CLASSA_MAX      128                              /* @A1A*/
#endif

#ifndef IN_CLASSB
  #define IN_CLASSB(i)       (((long)(i) & 0xc0000000) == 0x80000000)
                                                              /* @A1A*/
#endif
#ifndef IN_CLASSB_NET
  #define IN_CLASSB_NET      0xffff0000                       /* @A1A*/
#endif
#ifndef IN_CLASSB_NSHIFT
  #define IN_CLASSB_NSHIFT   16                               /* @A1A*/
#endif
#ifndef IN_CLASSB_HOST
  #define IN_CLASSB_HOST     0x0000ffff                       /* @A1A*/
#endif
#ifndef IN_CLASSB_MAX
  #define IN_CLASSB_MAX      65536                            /* @A1A*/
#endif

#ifndef IN_CLASSC
  #define IN_CLASSC(i)       (((long)(i) & 0xe0000000) == 0xc0000000)
                                                              /* @A1A*/
#endif
#ifndef IN_CLASSC_NET
  #define IN_CLASSC_NET      0xffffff00                       /* @A1A*/
#endif
#ifndef IN_CLASSC_NSHIFT
  #define IN_CLASSC_NSHIFT   8                                /* @A1A*/
#endif
#ifndef IN_CLASSC_HOST
  #define IN_CLASSC_HOST     0x000000ff                       /* @A1A*/
#endif

#ifndef IN_CLASSD
  #define IN_CLASSD(i)       (((long)(i) & 0xf0000000) == 0xe0000000)
                                                              /* @A2A*/
#endif

#ifndef IN_MULTICAST
  #define IN_MULTICAST(i)    IN_CLASSD(i)                     /* @A2A*/
                                                              /* @A2A*/
#endif

#if ((_XOPEN_SOURCE+1>520) && !defined(COMPAT_43))            /* @A4A*/

  #define _IN_ADDR_T                                          /* @A4A*/
#endif                                                        /* @A4A*/

#endif /* End changes for _XOPEN_SOURCE                          @A4A*/

#ifndef _IN_PORT_T                    /* transport layer port    @A5M*/
  typedef unsigned short in_port_t;
  #define _IN_PORT_T
#endif

struct in_addr {                      /* internet address            */

   u_long          s_addr;            /* IP address                  */

};

#ifndef __cplusplus
struct ip_opts {                      /* IP options                  */

   struct in_addr ip_dst;             /* first address if source
                                         routing option exists,
                                         zero if no source routing
                                         option                      */
   char    ip_opts[40];               /* IP options (variable size)  */

};
#endif
struct in6_addr {                     /* internet address        @A5A*/
        union {
                uint32_t        u6_addr32[4];
                uint16_t        u6_addr16[8];
                uint8_t         u6_addr8[16];
        } u6_addr;
};
#define s6_addr32       u6_addr.u6_addr32                     /* @A5A*/
#define s6_addr16       u6_addr.u6_addr16                     /* @A5A*/
#define s6_addr8        u6_addr.u6_addr8                      /* @A5A*/
#define s6_addr         u6_addr.u6_addr8                      /* @A5A*/

extern const struct in6_addr in6addr_any, in6addr_loopback;   /* @A5A*/

/* Start changes for _XOPEN_SOURCE                               @A4A*/
#if ((_XOPEN_SOURCE+1>520) && !defined(COMPAT_43))
/* _XOPEN_SOURCE is defined to be >= 520 & not BSD 4.3 compatibility */

#ifndef _SA_FAMILY_T
  typedef uchar sa_family_t;
  #define _SA_FAMILY_T
#endif

struct sockaddr_in {                  /* socket address (internet)   */

   uint8_t         sin_len;           /* address length              */
   sa_family_t     sin_family;        /* address family (AF_INET)    */
   u_short         sin_port;          /* port number                 */
   struct in_addr  sin_addr;          /* IP address                  */
   char            sin_zero[8];       /* reserved - must be 0x00's   */

};

struct sockaddr_in6 {
   uint8_t         sin6_len;       /* length of this struct      @A5A*/
   sa_family_t     sin6_family;    /* AF_INET6                   @A5A*/
   in_port_t       sin6_port;      /* transport layer port #     @A5A*/
   uint32_t        sin6_flowinfo;  /* IPv6 flow information      @A5A*/
   struct in6_addr sin6_addr;      /* IPv6 address               @A5A*/
   uint32_t        sin6_scope_id;  /* set of scope interfaces    @A5A*/
};
#define SIN6_LEN                   /*                            @A5A*/

#else
/* _XOPEN_SOURCE is not defined to be >= 520 or BSD 4.3 compatibility*/

#ifndef _SA_FAMILY_T
  typedef unsigned short sa_family_t;
  #define _SA_FAMILY_T
#endif

struct sockaddr_in {                  /* socket address (internet)   */

   short           sin_family;        /* address family (AF_INET)    */
   u_short         sin_port;          /* port number                 */
   struct in_addr  sin_addr;          /* IP address                  */
   char            sin_zero[8];       /* reserved - must be 0x00's   */

};

struct sockaddr_in6 {
   sa_family_t     sin6_family;    /* AF_INET6                   @A5A*/
   in_port_t       sin6_port;      /* transport layer port #     @A5A*/
   uint32_t        sin6_flowinfo;  /* IPv6 traffic class & flow  @A5A*/
   struct in6_addr sin6_addr;      /* IPv6 address               @A5A*/
   uint32_t        sin6_scope_id;  /* set of scope interfaces    @A5A*/
};

#endif /* End changes for _XOPEN_SOURCE                          @A4A*/

/*********************************************************************/
/* sockaddr_afinetx structure for AF_INET and AF_INET6 addresses @A9A*/
/*********************************************************************/
union sockaddr_afinetx                                        /* @A9A*/
{                                                             /* @A9A*/
  struct sockaddr_in  sinstruct;                              /* @A9A*/
  struct sockaddr_in6 sin6struct;                             /* @A9A*/
};                                                            /* @A9A*/

/*********************************************************************/
/* Argument structure for IP_ADD_MEMBERSHIP and IP_DROP_MEMBERSHIP.  */
/*                                                               @A2A*/
/*********************************************************************/
struct ip_mreq {                /*                               @A2A*/
  struct in_addr imr_multiaddr; /* IP multicast address of group @A2A*/
  struct in_addr imr_interface; /* local IP address of interface @A2A*/
};                              /*                               @A2A*/

/*********************************************************************/
/* Argument structure for IP_BLOCK_SOURCE, IP_UNBLOCK_SOURCE,        */
/* IP_ADD_SOURCE_MEMBERSHIP, and IP_DROP_SOURCE_MEMBERSHIP       @A7A*/
/*********************************************************************/
struct ip_mreq_source {         /*                               @A7A*/
  struct in_addr imr_multiaddr; /* IP multicast address of group @A7A*/
  struct in_addr imr_sourceaddr;/* local IP address of source    @A7A*/
  struct in_addr imr_interface; /* local IP address of interface @A7A*/
};                              /*                               @A7A*/

/*********************************************************************/
/* Argument structure for IPV6_JOIN_GROUP and IPV6_LEAVE_GROUP   @A5A*/
/*********************************************************************/
struct ipv6_mreq {                  /*                           @A5A*/
  struct in6_addr ipv6mr_multiaddr; /* IPv6 multicast address    @A5A*/
  unsigned int    ipv6mr_interface; /* IPv6 interface index      @A5A*/
};                                  /*                           @A5A*/

/*********************************************************************/
/* Argument structure for IP_PKTINFO                             @A8A*/
/*********************************************************************/
struct in_pktinfo {
  struct in_addr ipi_addr;       /* IPv4 destination address     @A8A*/
  struct in_addr ipi_interface;  /* Interface which pkt was rcvd @A8A*/
};

/*********************************************************************/
/* Argument structure for IPV6_PKTINFO                           @A7A*/
/*********************************************************************/
struct in6_pktinfo {
  struct in6_addr ipi6_addr;        /* Src/dst IPv6 address      @A7A*/
  uint32_t        ipi6_ifindex;     /* Send/recv interface index @A7A*/
};

/*********************************************************************/
/* Argument structure for IPV6_PATHMTU                           @A7A*/
/*********************************************************************/
struct ip6_mtuinfo {
  struct sockaddr_in6 ip6m_addr; /* Dst addr including zone ID   @A7A*/
  uint32_t            ip6m_mtu;  /* Path MTU in host byte order  @A7A*/
};
/*********************************************************************/
/* Argument structure for MCAST_JOIN_GROUP and MCAST_LEAVE_GROUP @A7A*/
/*********************************************************************/
struct group_req {                     /*                        @A7A*/
  uint32_t                gr_interface;/* Interface index        @A7A*/
  struct sockaddr_storage gr_group;    /* Group address          @A7A*/
};                                     /*                        @A7A*/

/*********************************************************************/
/* Argument structure for MCAST_BLOCK_SOURCE, MCAST_UNBLOCK_SOURCE,  */
/* MCASE_JOIN_SOURCE_GROUP and MCAST_LEAVE_SOURCE_GROUP          @A7A*/
/*********************************************************************/
struct group_source_req {               /*                       @A7A*/
  uint32_t                gsr_interface;/* Interface index       @A7A*/
  struct sockaddr_storage gsr_group;    /* Group address         @A7A*/
  struct sockaddr_storage gsr_source;   /* Source address        @A7A*/
};                                      /*                       @A7A*/

/*********************************************************************/
/* IPv6 address macros (see RFC 2553 & RFC 2292)                 @A5A*/
/*********************************************************************/
#define IS_UNSPECIFIED6(a) \
        (((a).s6_addr32[0] == 0) &&  \
         ((a).s6_addr32[1] == 0) &&  \
         ((a).s6_addr32[2] == 0) &&  \
         ((a).s6_addr32[3] == 0))
#define IN6_IS_ADDR_UNSPECIFIED(p)      IS_UNSPECIFIED6(*p)

#define IS_LOOPBACK6(a) \
        (((a).s6_addr32[0] == 0) &&  \
         ((a).s6_addr32[1] == 0) &&  \
         ((a).s6_addr32[2] == 0) &&  \
         ((a).s6_addr32[3] == 1))
#define IN6_IS_ADDR_LOOPBACK(p)         IS_LOOPBACK6(*p)

#define IS_MULTIADDR6(a) \
      ((a).s6_addr8[0] == 0xff)
#define IS_LOCALADDR6(a)  \
      ((a).s6_addr8[0] == 0xfe)
#define IS_LINKLADDR6(a) \
        (IS_LOCALADDR6(a) && (((a).s6_addr8[1] & 0xc0) == 0x80))
#define IS_SITELADDR6(a) \
        (IS_LOCALADDR6(a) && (((a).s6_addr8[1] & 0xc0) == 0xc0))
#define IN6_IS_ADDR_MULTICAST(p)        IS_MULTIADDR6(*p)
#define IN6_IS_ADDR_LINKLOCAL(p)        IS_LINKLADDR6(*p)
#define IN6_IS_ADDR_SITELOCAL(p)        IS_SITELADDR6(*p)

#define IS_V4MAPPED6(a) \
        (((a).s6_addr32[0] == 0) &&  \
         ((a).s6_addr32[1] == 0) &&  \
         ((a).s6_addr32[2] == 0x0000FFFF))
#define IS_V4COMPAT6(a) \
        (((a).s6_addr32[0] == 0) &&  \
         ((a).s6_addr32[1] == 0) &&  \
         ((a).s6_addr32[2] == 0) &&  \
         ((a).s6_addr8[12] != 0))
#define IN6_IS_ADDR_V4MAPPED(p)         IS_V4MAPPED6(*p)
#define IN6_IS_ADDR_V4COMPAT(p)         IS_V4COMPAT6(*p)

#define MADDR6_SCOPE(a)         ((a).s6_addr8[1] & 0x0f)

#define MADDR6_SCP_NODE         0x1     /* node-local scope */
#define MADDR6_SCP_LINK         0x2     /* link-local scope */
#define MADDR6_SCP_SITE         0x5     /* site-local scope */
#define MADDR6_SCP_ORG          0x8     /* organization-local scope */
#define MADDR6_SCP_GLO          0xe     /* global scope */

#define IN6_IS_ADDR_MC_NODELOCAL(p) \
        (IS_MULTIADDR6(*p) && (MADDR6_SCOPE(*p) == MADDR6_SCP_NODE))
#define IN6_IS_ADDR_MC_LINKLOCAL(p) \
        (IS_MULTIADDR6(*p) && (MADDR6_SCOPE(*p) == MADDR6_SCP_LINK))
#define IN6_IS_ADDR_MC_SITELOCAL(p) \
        (IS_MULTIADDR6(*p) && (MADDR6_SCOPE(*p) == MADDR6_SCP_SITE))
#define IN6_IS_ADDR_MC_ORGLOCAL(p) \
        (IS_MULTIADDR6(*p) && (MADDR6_SCOPE(*p) == MADDR6_SCP_ORG))
#define IN6_IS_ADDR_MC_GLOBAL(p) \
        (IS_MULTIADDR6(*p) && (MADDR6_SCOPE(*p) == MADDR6_SCP_GLO))

#define ARE_EQUAL6(a,b) \
        (((a).s6_addr32[0] == (b).s6_addr32[0]) &&  \
         ((a).s6_addr32[1] == (b).s6_addr32[1]) &&  \
         ((a).s6_addr32[2] == (b).s6_addr32[2]) &&  \
         ((a).s6_addr32[3] == (b).s6_addr32[3]))
#define IN6_ARE_ADDR_EQUAL(pa,pb)       ARE_EQUAL6(*pa,*pb)


/*********************************************************************/
/* Hop-by-hop and destination options header functions(RFC 3542) @A7A*/

#if (__OS400_TGTVRM__ < 510) || \
  ((__OS400_TGTVRM__ >= 510) && !defined(__LLP64_IFC__))      /* @A7A*/

                               uint8_t *, socklen_t *,
                               void **);                       /*@A7A*/

#else

				 void * __ptr64 * __ptr64);    /*@A7A*/

QBFC_EXTERN int inet6_opt_find(void * __ptr64, socklen_t, int, uint8_t,
                               socklen_t * __ptr64,
			       void * __ptr64 * __ptr64);      /*@A7A*/

                               uint8_t * __ptr64, socklen_t * __ptr64,
                               void * __ptr64 * __ptr64);      /*@A7A*/

  #pragma map(inet6_opt_append, "inet6_opt_append_ts64")      /* @A7A*/

  #pragma map(inet6_opt_next, "inet6_opt_next_ts64")          /* @A7A*/
#endif /* ... __LLP64_IFC__                                      @A7A*/

QBFC_EXTERN int inet6_opt_finish(void *, socklen_t, int);      /*@A7A*/

                                  socklen_t);                  /*@A7A*/

                                     uint32_t);                /*@A8A*/

                             socklen_t);                       /*@A8A*/
